definitions.explanation: An authentic item as opposed to a fake or imitation.
A person with genuine skill or talent.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本物|ほんもの}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is this painting genuine or fake?

examples.japanese: {本物|ほんもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: I know the taste of the real thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本物|ほんもの}⟦そっくり→そっくり：00378_sokkuri⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実|じつ}は→実は：02524_jitsuha⟧⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This watch looks just like the real thing, but it's actually a fake.
examples.notes: ⟦{本物|ほんもの}そっくり→本物そっくり：noentry⟧ = just like the real thing
Figurative usage for a skilled person

examples.japanese: ⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けてきた→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧、{本物|ほんもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: She, who has continued to work hard for years, is the one with genuine ability.

examples.japanese: ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えてこそ→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧、{本物|ほんもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なれる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Only by overcoming tough training can you become a true athlete.

notes:
{本物|ほんもの} means the genuine article — something authentic as opposed to a fake. It can also describe a person with real skill or talent ("the real deal").

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {本物|ほんもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: genuine ~, real ~
- {本物|ほんもの}⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧: whether it's real or not
- {本物|ほんもの}⟦そっくり→そっくり：00378_sokkuri⟧: just like the real thing
- {本物|ほんもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧: real ability

ANTONYM: ⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧ (fake, counterfeit)
